title: Invertible continuous latent dynamic for long-term data assimilation in complex physical systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.02832v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Forward forecasting and data assimilation are the two important aspects in physical simulation: one propagates the state forward, the other recovers unknown states from sparse observations. Learned surrogates are normally built and benchmarked for forward forecasting, however, whether a surrogate could attain good performance in data assimilation tasks is valuable as well, as inverse problems are of paramount importance in the scientific domain. In this paper, we propose a continuous-time Koopman autoencoder whose latent dynamics obey $\frac{dz}{dt} = \mathbf{K}_{\mathrm{cont}} z$, yielding closed-form inference via $z(\tau) = \exp(\mathbf{K}_{\mathrm{cont}} \tau) z(0)$ at any horizon $\tau$ in a single step. This decouples forecast cost from forecast length at inference time, showing long-term stability and high efficiency in forward simulation, and also supports data assimilation as gradient-based optimization with cost independent

translated_abstract: 前向预报与数据同化是物理模拟中两个重要的方面：前者将系统状态向前传播，后者从稀疏观测中恢复未知状态。学习型代理模型通常针对前向预报任务构建和评估，然而，代理模型能否在数据同化任务中同样取得良好性能也极具价值，因为逆问题在科学领域中至关重要。本文提出了一种连续时间Koopman自编码器，其潜在动力学遵循 $\frac{dz}{dt} = \mathbf{K}_{\mathrm{cont}} z$，从而可以通过 $z(\tau) = \exp(\mathbf{K}_{\mathrm{cont}} \tau) z(0)$ 在任意预测时长 $\tau$ 下单步实现闭式推理。这将推理阶段的预报成本与预报长度解耦，在前向模拟中展现出长期稳定性与高效率，同时支持以基于梯度优化的方式进行数据同化，且其成本与（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出一种连续时间Koopman自编码器，通过闭式解使预测成本与预测长度解耦，在复杂物理系统的长期前向模拟与基于梯度优化的数据同化中同时实现高效率、长期稳定性与可逆性。
en_tdlr: A continuous-time Koopman autoencoder with closed-form inference decouples forecast cost from forecast length, achieving long-term stability and high efficiency for both forward simulation and gradient-based data assimilation in complex physical systems.
